adapters.authority_limit: The game engine owns behavior; the adapter does not infer gameplay balance.

adapters.canonical_geometry: source-hash-bound GLB LOD, collision and socket records
adapters.authority_limit: Exposes bounded runtime data only; it creates no engine physics, gameplay behavior, project writes or receiving-game acceptance.

adapters.canonical_geometry: unchanged source-bound geometry plus reversible portable presentation deltas
adapters.authority_limit: Portable PBR fallbacks and optional renderer hints are not final shaders, textures, images or receiving-engine proof.
Mass and body settings are simulation values, not measured engineering data.
No actuators, controllers, calibrated inertia, safety case, emergency stop, or physical-control authority.

adapters.canonical_geometry: metre-correct bounds, connectors and clearance zones
adapters.authority_limit: Not building-code, accessibility, fire-safety, structural, or permit evidence.

adapters.canonical_geometry: source-bound model plus camera, lighting and effects intent
adapters.authority_limit: Presentation recipe only; no final-art approval is implied.

adapters.canonical_geometry: full archive 3MF/STL/parametric source; never the game GLB
adapters.authority_limit: No automatic production, tolerances, strength, material, slicer, printer, or legal-safety certification.

adapters.canonical_geometry: GLB remains the referenced geometry source
adapters.authority_limit: Text preview only; native USD Physics schemas and usdchecker validation are not claimed.
Explode vectors are starter illustration intent, not assembly instructions.

shared_root: shape + material + assembly + movement + scale + source identity + human intent
merge_rule: Adapters may translate the shared object, but no adapter silently rewrites the canonical v0.4 geometry or promotes HOLD outputs.
